params.negative: low quality, ugly, unfinished, out of focus, deformed, disfigure, blurry, smudged, restricted palette, flat colors

card.summary: The raw Chroma1-Base (512px foundational model; Chroma1-HD is its high-res finetune). Uncensored, T5-only, real CFG. Lower native resolution than HD — prefer HD for finished work.
card.pick_when: You specifically want the raw 512px Chroma base (e.g. for its look or as a finetune reference); otherwise use Chroma1-HD.

prompt.guidance: Natural-language prose; T5-only. Real CFG with a negative.
prompt.example: A windswept cliff at dawn, a lone figure in a red cloak facing the sea, dramatic clouds, painterly, highly detailed
prompt.instructions: Descriptive natural language (T5 only, no CLIP). ~26 steps, cfg 4.0, euler, beta scheduler, shift 1. Min-padding tokenization applied for you.
dont: Expect CLIP-tag prompting to be optimal

speed.measured_note: 24 GB build; not yet benchmarked on this box.
